s1.syndrome_frame: Acute presentation of a teenager with shock, seizure, and multi-organ dysfunction
salient_findings: Hemodynamic shock requiring intubation and vasopressor support
Elevated troponin and brain natriuretic peptide levels
key_facts: 16-year-old male with chromosome 18q deletion and well-controlled epilepsy
Four days of fever prior to presentation
One generalized seizure at home
Mother was ill with a cough
Normal echocardiogram in 2016
Required intubation and intravenous epinephrine infusion
Received intravenous stress-dose hydrocortisone
Troponin-I peaked at 32 ng/mL
N-terminal brain natriuretic peptide peaked at 9959 pg/mL
Low ADAMTS13 activity
Elevated von Willebrand factor activity
Normal fibrinogen concentration
Evidence of kidney injury, liver injury, and coagulopathy
Bilateral hazy opacities on chest radiographs
Moderately depressed biventricular function on echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
shortlist.why_kept: Low ADAMTS13 activity and elevated von Willebrand factor activity

shortlist.label: Severe sepsis
shortlist.why_kept: Evidence of shock, fever, and multi-organ dysfunction

shortlist.label: Myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Moderately depressed biventricular function and elevated troponin-I

shortlist.label: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
shortlist.why_kept: Evidence of coagulopathy and kidney injury

shortlist.label: Septic shock
shortlist.why_kept: Hemodynamic shock requiring intravenous epinephrine infusion and stress-dose hydrocortisone

raw.rationale: The patient presented with hemodynamic shock requiring intubation, intravenous fluids, and epinephrine infusion, which is consistent with septic shock. The patient also had a fever, a generalized seizure, and a mother who was ill with a cough, suggesting a possible infectious etiology. Additionally, the patient had evidence of kidney injury, liver injury, and coagulopathy, which are common complications of septic shock.

rejected.label: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
rejected.why: Although the patient had low ADAMTS13 activity and elevated von Willebrand factor activity, the clinical presentation and laboratory findings are more consistent with septic shock than TTP.

rejected.label: Severe sepsis
rejected.why: The patient's condition meets the criteria for septic shock, which is a subset of severe sepsis with hemodynamic instability, rather than just severe sepsis.

rejected.label: Myocarditis
rejected.why: While the patient had moderately depressed biventricular function and elevated troponin-I, the clinical presentation and laboratory findings are more consistent with septic shock than myocarditis.

rejected.label: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
rejected.why: Although the patient had evidence of coagulopathy, the clinical presentation and laboratory findings are more consistent with septic shock than DIC.
